about.headline: Crafting Digital Excellence

bio.name: Nitin Kanzariya
paragraphs: I'm a Full Stack Developer and AI Platform Engineer with 2.5+ years of experience designing, building, and shipping production-grade SaaS applications end to end. My work spans the full spectrum — from interactive React/Next.js frontends and real-time WebSocket systems to high-throughput Node.js APIs, Python FastAPI microservices, and .NET backends. I don't just write features; I architect systems that scale.

What sets me apart is the intersection of full-stack engineering and applied AI. I've built RAPTOR-style tree-based RAG pipelines with LangGraph, designed multi-LLM orchestration supporting OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq, and Ollama, and implemented agentic tool-calling systems where AI agents autonomously query live PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB databases — with human-in-the-loop approval gates for safety. I don't use AI as a buzzword; I engineer production AI systems with proper guardrails.

strengths: Architecting multi-tenant SaaS platforms with complete billing, RBAC, and SSO
Building RAG-powered AI agents using LangGraph, LangChain, and tree-based indexing (RAPTOR)
Multi-LLM orchestration across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq, and Ollama
Full-stack development with React 19, Next.js 16, Node.js, Express 5, Python FastAPI, and .NET
Real-time systems using Socket.io, SignalR, WebSockets, and Firebase
Database tool access with AI-driven query execution across PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB

projects.headline: Featured Projects

items.title: Aegis — AI Customer Support Platform
items.description: Production-grade, multi-tenant AI customer support SaaS platform with 4-service distributed architecture — Next.js 16 dashboard, Express.js 5 API with 18+ controllers and 19 Mongoose models, Python FastAPI AI microservice with a 6-node LangGraph agent pipeline featuring RAPTOR-style RAG retrieval, multi-LLM routing (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, Ollama), autonomous database tool execution with human approval gates, and an embeddable Vite/React chat widget with i18n. Includes Stripe billing, SAML SSO, Socket.io real-time chat, and BullMQ job queues.

items.title: RAG ChatBot
items.description: Full-stack AI chatbot platform with dynamic LLM model switching across multiple providers, personalized vector data stores per user, real-time file upload and document processing during conversations, and Pinecone-powered semantic search with context-aware retrieval. Features modular service architecture with separate chat persistence, document parsing pipeline (PDF, DOCX, web), intelligent chunking strategies, and a clean API layer for seamless frontend integration.

items.title: Status Page
items.description: Enterprise-grade real-time monitoring and notification platform built with .NET Core and Angular. Features SignalR-powered live status updates, multi-channel alert routing (email, SMS, push notifications), Slack slash command integration for Incident creation & manage, RBAC with granular permission controls, and dynamic dashboards with configurable chart layouts. Includes an embedded Python RAG chatbot for intelligent system health queries and natural-language outage status retrieval.

items.title: MUFASA
items.description: Full-stack stock and trading management system with deep Microsoft Outlook integration for automated email workflows, dynamic email tagging, and communication tracking. Features real-time Angular dashboards for portfolio monitoring and trade insights, RESTful Node.js API layer, and optimized MySQL database schemas designed for high-frequency financial transaction processing and multi-user data isolation.

items.title: Connection AI
items.description: Healthcare communications platform for pharmaceutical workflows — enabling document upload, intelligent PDF data extraction, and structured data management. Built with Next.js and Redux Thunk for predictable state management across complex multi-step workflows, seamless REST API integration with backend processing engines, and a polished responsive UI with Tailwind CSS optimized for clinical data entry and review workflows.

items.title: Photo Gallery
items.description: Social photo-sharing platform with Google OAuth authentication, friend discovery and following system, granular privacy controls for public/private uploads, and real-time chat between users. Features a rich media editor for photos and videos, Instagram-inspired engagement mechanics with likes and nested comment threads, advanced filtering and search, and Firebase Cloud Storage with real-time synchronization for instant content updates.

items.title: Hospital Management System
items.description: Cross-platform healthcare application serving both patients and doctors — featuring appointment scheduling, digital medical records management, prescription tracking, and automated health reporting. Built with Flutter for native-quality cross-device experiences, secured with Google Authentication, and powered by Firebase Cloud Firestore for real-time data synchronization and offline-capable operation. Includes an integrated real-time chat system for patient-doctor communication.

items.title: API & Backend Architecture
items.description: Secure, scalable backend systems built for real-world production loads. I design RESTful APIs with Express.js 5 and FastAPI, implement JWT authentication with httpOnly cookies and token rotation, build multi-tenant data isolation across Mongoose/MongoDB schemas, integrate Stripe for billing, and set up SAML SSO for enterprise clients. My backends include rate limiting, request validation with Zod, webhook delivery, and comprehensive error handling.
